1669-3263-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
1669-3263-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
1669-3263-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

215-3499-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
215-3499-4188.description:

Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4798-5632-7435.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4798-5632-7435.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers. Holding priority, activate Hardened Academic by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a 2/2 Detective creature token and a Clue token.
Repeat from step 2.

3259-7262-7296.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
3259-7262-7296.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7262-7296.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
3259-7262-7296.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

224-2573-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-2573-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull is a creature and has at least two charge counters on it.
224-2573-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Hearthhull
Repeat.

628-3967-7191.description:

When Bristlebane Battler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

3532-4928-5078-6556.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4928-5078-6556.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

662-6871-7033.description:
Cause Bumi to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Bumi triggers, untapping all lands you control, including Bumi as it's a land due to Toph, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat step 2 each combat phase.

1069-2510-7070.notablePrerequisites:
There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
1069-2510-7070.description:

Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The equip ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Repeat.

3532-3594-5078-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3532-3594-5078-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6608-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3532-5078-6608-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1018-2091-6785.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
1018-2091-6785.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Devastating Onslaught by paying {4}{R}, creating two token copies of Skullwinder with haste.
When the Skullwinder tokens enter, they trigger, returning Mana Geyser and Devastating Onslaught from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1414-3464.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lotus Petal.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Hyrax Tower Scout.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2034-4053-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
2034-4053-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

2034-2363-4030-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3664-5701-5720-5721-6763.notablePrerequisites:
There are two mana-producing land cards in your graveyard.
There are three or more card types among cards in your graveyard excluding the "Creature" type.
3664-5701-5720-5721-6763.description:
Play Lotus Field. When it enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the Lotus Field trigger, sacrificing it and Echoing Deeps.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer. Choose to have Echoing Deeps enter as a copy of Lotus Field.
When Echoing Deeps and Lotus Field enter, they each trigger.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps, Lotus Field and two other mana-producing lands except Shifting Woodland by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the Echoing Deeps and Lotus Field triggers, sacrificing them and the lands tapped for mana in step 6.
Activate Shifting Woodland's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer. Choose to have Echoing Deeps enter as a copy of Lotus Field.
Repeat from step 5.

215-3390-3518-6751-6865.description:
Cast Astelli Reclaimer for its warp cost by paying {2}{W}.
When Astelli Reclaimer enters, it triggers twice, returning Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Astelli Raclaimer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-3390-3518-6751-6865.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can continue the combo returning any noncreature, nonland permanents with mana value 5 or less. You should instead cast Astelli Reclaimer for its normal mana cost in this case.

104-261-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-261-4186.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
When Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

When Bloodied Ghost dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. When it enters, Bloodied Ghost will put a -1/-1 counter on itself, removing the +1/+1 counter.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2577-5468-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5468-5670.description:

When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Kambal's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2105-2292-3719-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven creatures, excluding Combat Celebrant, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Combat Celebrant or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
2105-2292-3719-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping seven creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

Animate Gilded Lotus using Workshop Elders.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gilded Lotus.

Activate the Bog Initiate token by paying {0} due to Sam, adding {B}.

1335-4772-4929.description:

Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
Once Cryptic Trilobite has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may remove them for infinite mana, then repeat step 1 to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Marath, which can then be used for Marath's other modes.

Hullbreacher replaces the card drawn with you creating a Treasure token.
